newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Clabecq shares not suspended - bourse.
newsitem.headline: Clabecq shares not suspended - bourse.

text.p: Shares in troubled Belgian steel maker Forges de Clabecq will trade as normal once the market opens, the Brussels bourse said on Wednesday.
"There will be no suspension of Clabecq shares," a bourse source said.
Belgian radio earlier said the European Commission rejected a 1.5 billion franc rescue plan for the steel maker because it constituted inadmissable state aid.
Clabecq closed at 91 francs on Tuesday, but indicative bid and ask prices early Wednesday stood at 20 francs at 0940 GMT.
The stock is traded on the cash market where shares are normally subjected to two price fixings a day, but the bourse has imposed a 10 percent maximum markdown per day after an excess of sellers.
